explanation: Heavy masses (17.1,14.7) with G~4.79 collide inside softening length 0.3. At step 29 distance 0.94 energy ~26 near E0. By step 30 distance 0.704 energy drops to 1.1, step31 distance 0.428 energy -101, step32 distance 0.105 energy -292 -> change 318 vs allowed 146. Leapfrog adaptive substeps only increase 11->12->13->16, insufficient to resolve acceleration scaling as 1/(r^2+0.09)^1.5, causing large systematic energy loss. Reducing dt from 0.01356 to 0.003 with same initial conditions eliminates violation, proving time-resolution bug.
